ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Letterpress & Relief Printing. Moving beyond the wood block print, students will experiment with a variety of traditional and contemporary relief printmaking techniques, including hand carving, letterpress, and digital technologies incorporating use of the laser cutter and CNC router. Projects that relate to work developed in other studio and design areas is encouraged. Hands-on making will be combined with discussion of the historical arc of printmaking and unique conceptual concerns of print media. This course will explore a range of materials, and works produced will range in scale from hand-held to wall-sized. Undergraduate Section.
